verifiedScope.proxy: Hector Hugh Munro’s lifetime fiction and satirical-sketch first-book-publication span, from The Westminster Alice to Beasts and Super-Beasts, used as a publishing proxy rather than a full-career span or a claim of uninterrupted writing. The seven markers use first English-language book years, not composition, newspaper serialization, translation or reissue dates. The Westminster Alice (1902) collects political sketches that began appearing in The Westminster Gazette in 1900. When William Came was published in November 1913 despite its 1914 book date. The history The Rise of the Russian Empire (1900), journalism and plays are outside this scope. The Toys of Peace (1919) and The Square Egg (1924) were collected posthumously and do not extend the bar; periodical writing continued after 1914.
